bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
value="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts d JOIN link_button_posts p ON p.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id AND p.share_code=d.data->>'shareCode' WHERE d.module='link' AND d.data->>'text'='個別編集済みの安全テスト' AND p.revision=2 AND (d.data->>'linkEditingRegistered')='false';")" || exit 62
test "$value" = 1 || exit 80
echo LINK_REGISTERED_EDIT_DB_REV2=PASS
